interactions.title: The egg, the remembered vision, and the fading power
lines: DM: And this is the image that each of your characters experiences… as you sleep. And as you dream, not a dreamless dream but a dream of this image. Of this… beautiful egg that infuses you with this image of home.
DM: And as you open your eyes, you—you all… reflect back on what seems like another dream. You remember a vision. A way in which you… were in a scene that filled you with so much terror and despair.
DM: A red sky. A feeling of… everything was lost. Burnt. Destroyed. And the image of a dragonet lying broken, wings contorted, its last gasping breaths. You. In a pool of blood. You.
DM: With an amber skin—amethyst skin. And you remember going into that dragonet and suddenly experiencing that dragonet's last breaths. And experiencing the last moments of that dragon.

DM: But it's seeing a light hurtling towards it, and knowing that it needed to stay alive for just another moment. Just to catch the energy of this beautiful light, whatever it was. And that as the light enveloped this dragonet, suddenly, the dragonet felt… home.

DM: That was the image. That was the word. And it was experiencing all the ways that it ever felt home in the arms of its best friend getting nuzzled and scratched under the chin by a hand, by a jade hand. A lizard man and a kenku and a—another warrior or ranger.

DM: And then, an image of an island full of its family. And hurtling through the sky, through the cosmos, through a psychedelic maze into a clearing with a storm and then passing through that storm. And into… a palm where… the egg landed.
DM: And each of you, in a moment of inspiration, hug that egg. And as you did, each of you experienced something profound. A moment that was sacred, that none of you have ever experienced before.

DM: Zeno, you experienced… the ability to both hear and recognize tones and a type of collective sound and music that you've never heard before. The precise tuning of intervals, the ability to create something in your mind: symphonies that you've never heard before and symphonies that you know that if were heard by very specific entities, by a dolphin, by your mother, by the plants nearby, that they would be in ecstasy.

DM: Heska, you felt for, in your system, the ability to just control every single fiber of your body. The way that you were able to hunt that king crab. Somehow, it's like you could have hunted a thousand of those king crabs. You felt… Your ability to discern any danger, your ability to strike at will at the moment that needed it was more precise than you could have ever possibly imagined.

DM: Little Tony, you felt for the first time ever the ability to not only tune in to any object that you wanted, and tune the volume and the amplitude, so for once, you could be like, "Shut the up," and it would shut the up, or like, "I wanna listen to you," and you could listen to that. Ultra-high resolution, 360 surround sound, complete control. And also, to the extent that you play with it, you could extend that consciousness out and out and out. And it felt like you could almost envelop the entire island, and tune into any object on the entire island. Which… was both an overwhelming and humbling, sacred experience for you.

DM: And Sculpit. Your entire life, you've had this strange… energy, this magic surging through you that you can never quite control, that would manifest in strange ways, and suddenly you'd be on the palms, suddenly you'd be near the storm and sudden, and for the first time for you as well. You felt an ability to move anywhere that you wanted, you imagined that if you could suddenly be in the heart of the temple, you could go there. If you wanted to travel to any location on the island at any moment—all of that turbulence, all of that wild energy was so calm and so peaceful inside of you.

DM: And so, for each of you, after having this vision, and this experience, you sleep. You sleep. And the only image in your minds is this beautiful, beautiful sacred egg even though you've encountered it just for the first time last night. Something about it is something that you've always known that has been a part of you in some deep, profound way. That symbolized home, and feels like home. And as you awake.

DM: And as the sun begins to rise, you notice that… this egg is… no longer glowing. It's now, it feels like whatever energy or whatever, yeah, whatever energy had been animating the egg is now, is now gone. And those feelings of great sacred power that you all felt for that period—and it felt it was—it's very hard to discern time. Like, you don't know how long it was that you were in that state feeling that power. But… you now… wake up from, rest of… Who knows how long? Back to yourself again, feeling, feeling, you know, quote unquote normal, whatever that might feel.
